title: Personalize Valentine proposal text and HTML page title

requirements.summary: Update the proposal card headline to show “Hina,” on the first line and “will you be my Valentine?” on the second line.
acceptanceCriteria: The card headline renders exactly as two lines: "Hina," on the first line and "will you be my Valentine?" on the second line.
No other user-facing text is changed as part of this requirement.

file_operations.description:
Change the proposal

headline content from the current recipient name to exactly: "Hina," followed by a line break and then "will you be my Valentine?" (preserve existing
and do not alter other visible strings).

requirements.summary: Set the browser tab title to exactly “Be My Valentine 💘”.
acceptanceCriteria: The document/page title shown in the browser tab is exactly "Be My Valentine 💘".

file_operations.description: Update the <title> tag text to exactly "Be My Valentine 💘" (including the emoji) to match the provided HTML title.
